name: Ogopogo
description: A serpentine lake creature reported in Okanagan Lake, British Columbia, Canada. Rooted in the long-standing Nx̌ax̌aitkʷ tradition of the Syilx (Okanagan) people, it became a settler-era cryptid in the late 19th century and one of Canada's most famous lake monsters under the name 'Ogopogo' from 1926 onward.

aliases.name: Nx̌ax̌aitkʷ
aliases.meaning: Approximately 'sacred creature/spirit of the water', often translated 'water demon' or 'water god'

aliases.name: Ogopogo
aliases.meaning: Coined from a 1924 English music-hall song 'The Ogo-Pogo: The Funny Foxtrot'

origin: Reports are confined to Okanagan Lake (a 127-km-long fjord lake reaching 232 m / 762 ft depth) and immediately adjacent waters in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia.
